bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
q="SELECT count(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations m JOIN topic_dm_entry_pins p ON p.chat_id=m.chat_id AND p.message_id=m.message_id WHERE m.state='uncertain' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM posting_topics t WHERE t.chat_id=p.chat_id AND t.message_thread_id=p.message_thread_id AND t.purpose='link') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM board_menu_panels b WHERE b.chat_id=p.chat_id AND b.message_thread_id=p.message_thread_id AND b.panel_type='general_guide') OR p.title ILIKE '%総合案内%' OR p.title ILIKE '%コミュニテーリング%' OR p.title ILIKE '%相互リング%' OR p.title ILIKE '%ﾘﾝｸ%' OR p.title ILIKE '%コミュニティリンク%');"
v="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "$q")" || exit 60
case "$v" in ''|*[!0-9]*)exit 61;;esac
test "$v" -le 50 || exit 62
exit $((100+v))
